institutional_scope: U.S. District Court, District of Massachusetts

remedy.notes: On November 20, 2024, the District of Massachusetts approved the class settlement and dismissed the claims against SafeRent with prejudice (ECF 135). The order limits certification to settlement purposes and precludes using the settlement as an admission of wrongdoing.
